what: Routing check, a stand-in for the app trigger test (the command-line trigger loop cannot sign in here). A separate agent saw only the six sibling skill descriptions from main 6e290b0 plus this skill's (seven in all), and picked one skill per prompt, blind to the expected answer.
result: 19 of 20. All 10 data prompts went to wugweb-engineer; all 10 near misses went to another skill. The one mismatch (13) went to wugweb-voice instead of the expected wugweb-work, not to wugweb-engineer.
